audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows disagreed across layers: phases[].side read Skill on rows 0-3, 5 and 6 while content win[] and packet.levelChart read Lissandra on all seven.
audit.why: Galio's only engage is Justice Punch at 650 range and his taunt needs 275; Lissandra pokes at 725, roots at 450 and leaves at 1050. There is no stage where he holds the lane, which is also what the 51.56% win rate over 2,335 games reflects.
audit.corrected: All six stale sides moved to Lissandra as one atomic group, with two whys regrounded in his real ranges and cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hero's Entrance was discussed as a dive threat with no cooldown attached; it is 180s at rank 1, the longest cooldown either champion owns.
audit.why: A 180s global is a tempo asset, not a lane threat — the punish window after he uses it is three minutes long, and the page never told the player to take anything during it.
audit.corrected: 180s stated in breakdown.cooldowns and turned into an actionable objective window in ahead.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never named Shield of Durand's shield or Colossal Smash's area auto-reset, and breakdown.cooldowns described Justice Punch only as 'his dash knockup'.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags both shield-absorbs-burst (W and R) and autoreset-burst-tell (P). Galio shields through the burst Lissandra is told to commit, and his passive makes standing in his wave cost extra.
audit.corrected: W's 18s taunt-plus-shield and the passive's area hit now appear where the player plans a trade; Justice Punch carries its 11s-to-7s and 650 range.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Justice Punch 11s to 7s, Shield of Durand 18s, Hero's Entrance 180s stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under unrelated titles; dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[1].d answered a different question than their titles asked.
audit.corrected: Four bullet bodies rewritten against their own titles.

edits.before: E claw completes the kit — you now have the lane's strangest engage and a guaranteed exit. Greed carefully; the claw is slow.
edits.after: Claw online at 1050 range — you can leave any Justice Punch window, and Galio has no second dash to follow you out.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q spam stops hurting your mana. Chip Galio every time he touches the wave.
edits.after: Yours: Winds of War is 11s at rank 1, so every gap between tornadoes is a free Q shatter.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your R Frozen Tomb (self-cast) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1, 7s at rank 5 and only 650 range — it is his one engage, so step up while it is down. - Shield of Durand taunts from 275 on 18s and shields him through your burst. - Hero's Entrance is 180s at rank 1.

edits.before: Galio wins by landing Justice Punch, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Galio wins by knocking you up with Justice Punch, taunting you into his team with Shield of Durand, and shielding through your burst.

edits.before: Ahead, hunt: claw into every river skirmish first, tomb the carry, and snowball picks — Galio farming under tower can't stop a roaming Lissandra.
edits.after: Ahead, take the tempo: Hero's Entrance is 180s at rank 1, so while it is down his team plays a lane short and you take the plates and mid tower.

edits.before: Carry through picks — claw-root-tomb converts vision into kills better than any control mage; the map shrinks every time your E is up.
edits.after: Carry by out-ranging a 275-range taunt — root him at 450, shatter through him, and never stand where Justice Punch reaches at 650.

edits.before: If Galio opens the score, reset expectations and respect Justice Punch doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q shatters and stay relevant through self-R utility.
edits.after: If Galio opens the score, respect the 650-range Justice Punch doubly and give it room. After a second, your job changes — farm with Q shatters and stay relevant through self-R utility.

edits.before: His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Justice Punch is 650 range and knocks up — root him as he lands and the knockup buys him nothing.

edits.before: Q-shatter his wave contact, and when he steps to punish, W-root into full rotation and walk — the root tax makes every aggressive step expensive.
edits.after: Your Q shards pass through the target and keep going, so a rooted Galio at 725 eats the spear and everything behind him takes it too.

edits.before: Galio burns Justice Punch on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Shield of Durand can be released early, so wait for the real commit.

edits.before: The claw is your entrance AND your exit — spending both directions on one greedy play is how Lissandras die famous.
edits.after: Colossal Smash turns one of every few autos into an area hit — inside his wave, his passive and the minions chip you together.

edits.before: Clawing in with W on cooldown 'to poke' — an engage tool spent on chip damage is a Lissandra standing in melee range with no ice left.
edits.after: With Justice Punch banked at 7s he knocks you up the moment you land — claw in only after the dash has already been spent.

notes: Content win[0..6] already matched packet.levelChart (Lissandra on all seven), so only the stale full-layer sides moved; no win[N] twin edits existed to make. Ratings left alone — a 51.56% win rate over 2,335 games does not obviously support the 5/10-to-6/10 spread, but the brief gives no basis to re-rate, so the rows were left as found. Not asserted: whether Shield of Durand's taunt is shortened by tenacity, whether Justice Punch's knockup can be avoided by Lissandra's self-R, and whether Hero's Entrance's landing shield applies before or after her Frozen Tomb damage.
